picks.headline: ChatGPT Sketch turns your bad drawings into detailed AI images
picks.excerpt: OpenAI's new ChatGPT Sketch mode lets you scribble a rough drawing and have Images 2.5 turn it into a detailed rendering, making a hand sketch part of the prompt. It pushes image generation toward the kind of sketch-and-refine loop designers already use.
picks.rationale: Sketch-as-prompt lands directly in the designer's ideation loop; a real shipped mode, not a demo.

picks.headline: Blackmagic Design releases DaVinci Resolve 21.1
picks.excerpt: Blackmagic has shipped DaVinci Resolve 21.1, a sizeable update to the free grading and editing app that adds an MCP server alongside new VFX and colour features. Exposing Resolve to AI agents over Model Context Protocol puts an agent directly inside a post-production timeline.
picks.rationale: An MCP server inside a free NLE means agents can drive a real post timeline today.

picks.headline: Autodesk's AI blueprint for CAD
picks.excerpt: Autodesk has laid out its AI blueprint for CAD, pairing geometry-aware models with project-level intelligence inside Fusion. The aim is an assistant that understands parts and constraints rather than just text, reshaping how engineers and industrial designers iterate.
picks.rationale: Geometry-aware models rather than text wrappers is the first credible shape of AI inside CAD.

picks.headline: Date Slop: building a deliberately bad UX with AI
picks.excerpt: A developer entered a Bad UX competition for the worst possible date picker and used AI to build it. The exercise turns into a sharp read on how readily generative tools produce plausible-looking but hostile interface patterns.
picks.rationale: Backfill for a paywalled pick; a built artefact plus concrete lessons on shipping an AI feature into a real UI.

picks.headline: Your AI-written brief might wreck your brand's chances of finding the right creatives
picks.excerpt: Design agencies say AI-generated client briefs are flattening the signals they used to read when deciding which founders to take a chance on. The result is a hiring and pitching process that filters out exactly the interesting work it was meant to attract.
picks.rationale: Changes how a brief gets written tomorrow; sourced from agencies actually rejecting the work.
